name: Theme Manager
description: Theme singleton managing CSS custom property application for dark/light modes and palette sets (default, monokai, idol). Maintains _base and _mode state. Sets 9 CSS custom properties (--bg, --surface, --panel, --primary, --secondary, --tertiary, --border, --accent, --accent2) on document.documentElement. Supports legacy theme name parsing (dark, light, monokai). Auto-applies default dark theme on import.

methods.name: get isDark
methods.description: Returns true if current mode is 'dark'

methods.name: get colors
methods.description: Returns current ThemeColors palette object, falls back to defaultDarkTheme

methods.name: setBase
methods.description: Sets palette base if valid ('default' | 'monokai'), triggers apply()

methods.name: setMode
methods.description: Sets mode if 'dark' or 'light', triggers apply()

methods.name: setTheme
methods.description: Sets base and optionally mode; supports legacy names ('dark'→default-dark, 'light'→default-light, 'monokai'→monokai-dark); triggers apply()

methods.name: setDark
methods.description: Resets base to 'default' and sets mode to 'dark' or 'light', triggers apply()

methods.name: toggle
methods.description: Toggles mode between 'dark' and 'light', triggers apply()

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Reads current ThemeColors and sets --bg, --surface, --panel, --primary, --secondary, --tertiary, --border, --accent, --accent2 CSS custom properties on document.documentElement

lifecycle.created_by: Module-level instantiation: `export const theme = new Theme()` followed by `theme.apply()` — created once at renderer import
lifecycle.destroyed_by: Lives for the duration of the renderer process
